summary: Anthropic's interpretability team shares a preliminary technique, turn-averaged sparse autoencoders, that averages residual streams across a conversational turn to reduce the number of SAE features needed to interpret model behavior, alongside related work on attribution graphs and persona-feature identification.

practices.reason: Turn-averaged SAEs offer a way to reduce feature-activation volume for auditing model transcripts, but the work is explicitly framed as preliminary and unpublished.
practices.quote: Since turns can extend for hundreds to thousands of tokens, turn-averaged SAEs substantially decrease the number of feature activations to interpret.
